verdict.rationale: The portal itself offers a form search ('Rechercher un formulaire') and a map of in-person service points ('carte des points d'accueil'), which partly cover the forms and addresses of an offline rail. The only phone number shown (0806 807 807) is an information line for e-invoicing, not a filing channel. Nothing in the evidence says paper or mail filing is accepted when the online flow is down. missing for 10: an explicit published fallback procedure for when online filing is unavailable, exact postal mailing addresses for submissions, fax numbers, mapping of which paper forms replace which online flows, and independent corroboration.
